meta.title: QQ Bot Channel
meta.description: OneBot v11 QQ bot channel. Receives QQ messages and images and answers through an OpenAI-compatible chat/vision endpoint. Keeps long-term per-user memory plus a short-term conversation window (so follow-ups like "and that one?" work; it resets after silence), splits long replies into several messages instead of truncating, and answers /help, /status, /new, /memory, /forget. Ships a DSH panel for status, QR-code login, one-click wiring, test messages, memory management and logs, plus a standalone /setup console.
